article.title: Later公布Creator Live，邀品牌和創作者討論長期合作
article.summary: Later計劃在紐約舉辦Creator Live，邀創作者、品牌和平台交流聯盟銷售與長期合作。
highlights: 議程列出POPFLEX創辦人Cassey Ho及YouTube、SharkNinja代表。
創作者須申請出席，名額有限。
article.why: 品牌可把與創作者的第一次合作設為有明確續約條件的試點。
article.next_step: 預先訂好素材使用權、佣金口徑和續約指標，向合作創作者交代。
article.detail: Later公布紐約Creator Live議程。Wayfair代表將與創作者討論如何從一次合作走向長期關係，POPFLEX創辦人Cassey Ho則與YouTube和SharkNinja代表談創作者經營。活動須申請出席。團隊可把素材使用權、佣金和續約條件列入初次合作的書面安排。
article.title_en: Later announces Creator Live with sessions on long-term creator partnerships
article.summary_en: Later plans a New York Creator Live event for creators, brands and platforms to discuss affiliate commerce and sustained partnerships.
highlights_en: The line-up includes POPFLEX founder Cassey Ho and speakers from YouTube and SharkNinja.
Creators must apply to attend and space is limited.
article.why_en: Brands can run a first creator collaboration as a pilot with clear renewal criteria.
article.next_step_en: Define usage rights, commission rules and renewal measures in advance and share them with creators.
article.detail_en: Later announced its New York Creator Live agenda. Wayfair and creators will discuss how one-off collaborations can become long-term relationships. POPFLEX founder Cassey Ho joins YouTube and SharkNinja speakers to discuss creator-led businesses. Attendance is by application. Set usage rights, commissions and renewal terms in writing at the outset.
